documents.title: Pathology report (TCGA-Reports)
documents.text: Sex: Female. Date of Tumour Procurement: 1. GROSS ASSESSMENT: Cut section showed a chalky white tumour. 4x3x2cm,. 2. MICROSCOPIC ASSESSMENT. Microscopic description: Section shows an invasive tumour growing in solid nests and. tubular patterns. It is composed of cells having moderately pleomorphic hyperchromatic. nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm. The stroma is desmoplastic containing thin-walled. vascular channels, tumour cells and lymphocytes. Focal areas of necrosis noted,. 3. Tumour Type: Malignant. 4. Tumour Site: Left Breast. 5. Distance of invasive carcinoma to closest margin: 5mm. Which margin? Deep resection. 6. HISTOLOGICAL DIAGNOSIS: Invasive ductal carcinoma, NOS. 7. COMMENTS: nil. Dr. Reporting Pathologist Name.
